ShortDescription.Value: Not Enough Customers fix for cities with 100s of these Notification icons.

Publish.LongDescription:
🛒 Tired of "Not Enough Customers" everywhere since recent game updates?
Got a city covered in NEC icons? Give this a try!
In my 130k city, 165 NEC warnings dropped to just 4 after about 30 minutes. No bulldozing hundreds of shops! Other city of 95k with 335 warnings dropped to 21 in 5 minutes, and only 6 in 20 min.
### What it does
* Slows Service production when shops get too full, before NEC gets out of hand. * Helps balance shopping demand so excess Service gets used up. * Helps Leisure businesses (Meals, Entertainment, Recreation) and hotels too. * Adaptive — kicks in when needed and backs off when shops are healthy. * Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony patches. Uses the game's existing systems.
### Support and Feedback * Easiest way to support is to click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested, just a free like for many days of work. * Feedback is welcome on Discord (links on the right). PRs are welcome on Github where the source code is.
### Credits and Thanks * RiverMochi: mod author * Sunny Scunny - testing
